extracted.intended_audience: public relations students and practitioners (writers, media-relations staff)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and technical standards for composing and distributing news releases (press releases) and accompanying materials for print, wire, radio, and television; also related media-relations logistics (press packets, press rooms, press conferences).

rubrics_metrics.name: News release checklist
rubrics_metrics.description: Checklist for preparing a news release (see index reference to checklist, p.388).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Index entry indicates there is a checklist for news releases (p.388). Related items in the book include format, dateline, slug word, headline, photographs, wire releases, broadcast adaptations, and simultaneous release with speeches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format of news release
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and acceptable formats for news releases (see 'format of, 383').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Book references a discussion of the news-release format on p.383; likely covers structure, ordering of elements, and formatting conventions used by journalists and wire services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dateline in news release
rubrics_metrics.description: Use and placement of a dateline in a news release (see 'Dateline, in news release, 388').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Index points to guidance on when and how to include a dateline (p.388), a common element reporters expect near the lead of a release.

rubrics_metrics.name: Headline — use of
rubrics_metrics.description: How to craft and use a headline for a news release (see 'Headline, use of, 388, 524').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References indicate guidance on headline construction and placement (p.388 and p.524); headlines are key to attracting editor/reporter attention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Slug word on news release
rubrics_metrics.description: Inclusion and use of a slug word on a news release (see 'Slug word, on news release, 389').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Index cites treatment of slug words (p.389), a technical newsroom element used for identification/tracking of releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargo (news)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of news embargoes for timed release of information (see 'Embargo, news, 388, 390').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Book references explain embargo practice and considerations (pp.388, 390), including timing and negotiation with media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wire releases / PR Newswire
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and use of wire releases and wire services (see 'wire releases, 391-392' and 'PR Newswire, 391-392').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Index points to material on preparing and distributing wire releases and how wire services handle them (pp.391-392), including formatting and distribution considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Broadcast news release (radio/television)
rubrics_metrics.description: Adaptation and formats of news releases for broadcast media (see 'broadcast, 389-390' and television '416-417').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References include guidance on news releases for radio (pp.389-390, radio scripts) and television adaptations (pp.416-417), plus considerations for fone feeds and submission formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photographs accompanying press releases
rubrics_metrics.description: Selection, cropping, cutlines, sizing, submission and permissions for photographs paired with press releases (see 'photographs accompanying, 471-474' and related photo entries).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Index lists multiple photo-related topics: cropping (456, 475-477), cutlines (473-474), selection and sizing (456, 477-478), permissions and photographic release form (208, 474), and submission for television (474). These are the practical photo standards accompanying releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photographic release form / permissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of release/permission forms for photographs used with press releases (see 'Photographic release form, 208' and 'Permissions, photo, 474').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Index indicates discussion of legal/permission requirements for photographs (pp.208, 474), an important safeguard when distributing images with releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Puffery in news release (anti-pattern)
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoidance/recognition of puffery in press releases (see 'puffery in, 375').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference flags puffery as a problematic practice (p.375); guidance likely addresses how to avoid exaggerated or promotional language that undermines credibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Objectivity and bias in writing
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards of objectivity and avoidance of bias in PR writing (see 'Objectivity, in writing, 377' and 'Bias, in writing, 377').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Index entries point to guidance on maintaining objectivity and avoiding biased language in releases and other PR texts (p.377), tying to journalistic norms and ethics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Style conventions — Associated Press Style Manual
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of AP style and other style conventions for news releases (see 'Style Manual, Associated Press, 383, 389').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Index indicates adoption of AP Style recommendations for press materials (pp.383, 389), including punctuation, capitalization, datelines, and abbreviation usage expected by newsrooms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead time (publishing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Accounting for publication lead time when issuing releases (see 'Lead time, publishing, 465').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Index references consideration of lead time for publications (p.465); practitioners must time releases to match editors' production cycles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press packet / press room (press center) content and setup
rubrics_metrics.description: Contents and logistical standards for press packets and press rooms used when distributing releases and hosting media (see 'Press packet, 379' and 'Press room (press center), 401-402, 503').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References suggest guidance on assembling press packets (p.379) and operating a press room/center (pp.401-402, 503), including what materials reporters expect and how to stage media events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simultaneous release with speech
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinating a news release to be issued simultaneously with a speech (see 'simultaneous, with speech, 437-439').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Index points to procedures for synchronizing releases with speeches or events (pp.437-439), including timing and distribution methods so media can report accurately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photographs: cutlines and credit lines
rubrics_metrics.description: Crafting cutlines and credit lines for photographs used with releases (see 'Cutline, photo, 473-474' and 'Photographers, credit line, 474').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Index entries indicate standards for descriptive cutlines and photographer credits (pp.473-474), which accompany photos in press materials and affect usability by news outlets.
